history.name: CSVHandling_Expert
history.content:
The structure appears consistent: each book is five lines (Title, Author, Publisher, Genre, Status), grouped by category headers. I’ll parse the entire text, build a DataFrame, filter Rick Riordan, and count those not on shelves.

Assumptions:
- Not on shelves = Status in {"Checked Out", "Overdue"}.
- Ignore category headers.

Code:

```python
import pandas as pd
from functions import extract_pdf_text

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/e9a2c537-8232-4c3f-85b0-b52de6bcba99.pdf"
text = extract_pdf_text(pdf_path)

lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.split('\n') if ln.strip()]
# Remove known headers/categories
headers = {"Scribe County Public Library","Title","Author","Publisher","Genre","Status","Books",
           "Young Children's","Middle Grade","Young Adult"}
content_lines = [ln for ln in lines if ln not in headers]

# Group every 5 lines into a book record
records = []
for i in range(0, len(content_lines), 5):
    chunk = content_lines[i:i+5]
    if len(chunk) == 5:
        records.append(chunk)

df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["Title","Author","Publisher","Genre","Status"])
riordan = df[df["Author"].str.lower().str.contains("rick riordan")]
not_on = riordan[riordan["Status"].isin(["Checked Out","Overdue"])]

print("Rick Riordan titles found:")
print(riordan[["Title","Status"]])
print("\nNumber of Rick Riordan books not currently on the shelves:", len(not_on))
```
